title: Technical
subtitle: Deeper detail behind the architecture decisions that make reporting reliable.
sectionTitle: The issue is not reporting. It is architecture.
sectionBody: Most CRE stacks were built to capture reality (payments, work orders, lease abstracts). They are great at looking backward. They struggle to forecast and connect decisions to P&L, employee experience, ESG goals, and risk. That gap turns teams into manual data janitors.

cards.title: The 80/20 trap
cards.body: Teams spend most of their time aggregating disconnected data and too little time making decisions.

cards.title: The vendor bias
cards.body: Service-provider data models optimize delivery for the vendor, not the occupier's strategy.

cards.title: The IT bottleneck
cards.body: Generalist data projects take years because the CRE semantics and grain are missing.
